items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: I think Mr. Wiggs knows him.

ctx.x: And our next caller for Mr. Johnny Wiggs and Mr. Dick Allen. Good morning. You're on the air.

Good morning. This is Mrs. Sal Gutierrez. I heard Mr. Chance mention just Raymond Burke and Harry Shields are still living. I wanted to say that Sal Gutierrez is still alive. He's an old jazz drummer, and he played at the Fern Dance Hall in 1925. I think Mr. Wiggs knows him.
Oh, yes. Very well. Very well. I know him, too. I've heard him many, many times. I enjoyed him.
